return(function(a,b,k)
local z="ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
local m={};for i=1,64 do m[string.byte(z,i)]=i-1 end
local o,c={},{};local n=0
local function q(v)n+=1;c[#c+1]=string.char(bit32.bxor(v,(k+n*17)%256));if #c>=2048 then o[#o+1]=table.concat(c);c={}end end
for i=1,#b,4 do
local x1,x2,x3,x4=string.byte(b,i,i+3)
local v=(m[x1]or 0)*262144+(m[x2]or 0)*4096+(m[x3]or 0)*64+(m[x4]or 0)
q(math.floor(v/65536)%256)
if x3~=61 then q(math.floor(v/256)%256)end
if x4~=61 then q(v%256)end
end
o[#o+1]=table.concat(c)
local f,e=loadstring(table.concat(o),"=Asta")
assert(f,e)
return f(string.format(a,string.format("%q",a),string.format("%q",b),k))
end)("return(function(a,b,k)\
local z=\"ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/\"\
local m={};for i=1,64 do m[string.byte(z,i)]=i-1 end\
local o,c={},{};local n=0\
local function q(v)n+=1;c[#c+1]=string.char(bit32.bxor(v,(k+n*17)%%256));if #c>=2048 then o[#o+1]=table.concat(c);c={}end end\
for i=1,#b,4 do\
local x1,x2,x3,x4=string.byte(b,i,i+3)\
local v=(m[x1]or 0)*262144+(m[x2]or 0)*4096+(m[x3]or 0)*64+(m[x4]or 0)\
q(math.floor(v/65536)%%256)\
if x3~=61 then q(math.floor(v/256)%%256)end\
if x4~=61 then q(v%%256)end\
end\
o[#o+1]=table.concat(c)\
local f,e=loadstring(table.concat(o),\"=Asta\")\
assert(f,e)\
return f(string.format(a,string.format(\"%%q\",a),string.format(\"%%q\",b),k))\
end)(%s,%s,%d)\
","",134)
